"Casino 7s" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $5 game with four top prizes of $100,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

The table below shows the full count for "Casino 7s", with every prize level included.
2775.headline: New game, all prizes left

2776.body:
"Patriotic Payout" just reached Texas stores with eight top prizes of $30,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

Everything here about "Patriotic Payout" comes from official Texas lottery numbers, current through October 19.
